comment: Ratchet: recall@5 must stay >= this. Raised 2026-10-10 (E3.6) from 0.84 to 0.97: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, reranker off, hybrid → 0.978 recall@5, 0.840 MRR, ~36 ms p50 on 45 es/en questions. Raise it deliberately when a change measurably improves recall; never lower it silently.
